trace.question: What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by an administrator whose first name is Alusine. List the district code of the school.

attempts.sql:
SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
       f.`District Code`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 'Alusine' IN (s.AdmFName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmFName3)

trace.final_sql:
SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
       f.`District Code`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 'Alusine' IN (s.AdmFName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmFName3)
trace.answer: The school administered by Alusine has 70.15% of students (K-12) eligible for free meals, and its district code is 64857.
